## Expected workflow and state transitions

For every individual implementation-file or test-file edit, immediately run the smallest relevant test set and record the snapshot state.

- `edit -> test -> failing`: do not commit or push. Permit only the next causal edit needed to address that failure, then test immediately again.
- `edit -> test -> passing`: stop implementation/test editing; perform a bounded lightweight sanity review, make only causal remediation if needed, then create a signed commit. Let the repository-owned pre-commit hook run the fast formatting, linting, unit, manifest/config, and similar checks that must pass before the next iteration. Push immediately when that hook passes.
- `pushed -> CI running`: begin the next iteration immediately while monitoring the exact pushed SHA concurrently. Do not serialize feature work on successful CI.
- `pushed -> CI failed`: immediately preempt ongoing feature work and enter the existing Tiber-owned recovery hold. Diagnose causality and perform one causal repair or an authorized unchanged-SHA rerun before resuming.
- `ticket implementation complete -> full review`: only when all planned increments are delivered and the agent is ready to call the ticket done, run the configured full multi-lens final review and required clean iterations. Any finding becomes a normal causal checkpoint before final review resets.

## Gate allocation

The lightweight checkpoint review, pre-commit gate, CI, and terminal full review are distinct.

- Lightweight review catches obvious correctness, maintainability, test-quality, and production-risk mistakes.
- Pre-commit contains only fast checks that must pass before another iteration safely starts.
- CI owns comprehensive, slow, integration, mutation, broad acceptance, and pipeline-scale checks. Do not run the same comprehensive suite in pre-commit, again as a local exact-commit gate, and again in CI.
- Full multi-lens review runs only before declaring the ticket done.
- When gate placement is ambiguous, ask “what would Kent Beck do?” Prefer the smallest fast feedback loop, one simple causal change, immediate focused testing, frequent reversible commits, and broader integration feedback in CI; use measured project risk where the heuristic is insufficient.

## Delivery modes and interruption

Direct-to-trunk pushes each passing checkpoint normally. Pull-request mode pushes the authorized branch checkpoint and monitors branch/PR CI without inferring permission to open or merge. Local-only mode records the locally permitted terminal checkpoint and that no remote CI is authorized. Never infer permission to amend, force-push, merge, delete remote state, or bypass protection.

An interruption leaves durable exact-snapshot evidence identifying whether work is failing, passing-awaiting-lightweight-review/pre-commit, committed, pushed-with-CI-running, or held for CI recovery.

## Bounded RED-to-GREEN exception

When a test and corresponding implementation cannot independently pass, allow one explicitly declared RED-to-GREEN pair: record the expected RED and causal claim, make only the paired implementation edit, test immediately, then enter lightweight review and checkpoint delivery at GREEN.

## Tests and required skill changes

Cover passing, failing, RED-to-GREEN, interruption/resume, all delivery modes, immediate push, concurrent CI monitoring, CI-failure preemption, non-duplication of comprehensive gates, and terminal-only full review. Update development-workflow, test-driven-development, and delivery contracts consistently; touch final-review and Tiber contracts only where sequencing or durable state integration requires it. Update model-mediated fixtures/graders and synchronized plugin metadata as required.
event_data.summary: Development work can accumulate several independently passing changes before any durable checkpoint is created. Require an immediate focused test after each implementation/test edit; when green, stop editing, perform a lightweight sanity review, create a signed commit, and push as soon as the repository’s fast pre-commit gate passes. Begin the next iteration immediately while monitoring exact-SHA CI concurrently. Keep comprehensive suites in CI and reserve the full multi-lens review for declaring the ticket done.
event_data.title: Preserve each passing development step as a delivered checkpoint
